assertion_results.text: Data extraction identifies the ecosystem as RPM based on the library name (openssl-libs) and component context, not Cargo (Step 1 Ecosystem detection — read ecosystems from Ecosystem Mappings config)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md 'Ecosystem Detection': "`openssl-libs` is a system package inside a container image, so the ecosystem is **RPM**." and "The 2.2.x Ecosystem Mappings table has an RPM row: Lock File `rpms.lock.yaml`, Check Command `git show <tag>:rpms.lock.yaml`...". Cargo is not mentioned anywhere.

assertion_results.text: Version impact table includes ALL versions from the 2.2.x stream supportability matrix (2.2.0 through 2.2.4) and uses rpms.lock.yaml data for version extraction (Step 2.3)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md section '2.3 – Dependency Versions (rpms.lock.yaml at pinned tags)' has a Version Impact Table with rows for 2.2.0 (3.0.7-25.el9_3), 2.2.1 (3.0.7-27.el9_4), 2.2.2 (retag of 2.2.1, result carried forward), 2.2.3 (3.0.7-28.el9_4) and 2.2.4 (3.0.7-28.el9_4). The column header is 'openssl-libs (rpms.lock.yaml)' and the command is `git show <tag>:rpms.lock.yaml | grep 'openssl-libs'`.

assertion_results.text: Dependency chain context identifies openssl-libs as present in rpms.lock.yaml and uses this to determine the package origin — the lock file presence is the primary classification signal (Step 2.3.5)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md section 2.3.5: "rpms.lock.yaml: present at v0.4.5 (3.0.7-25.el9_3), v0.4.8 ..., v0.4.11 / v0.4.12 (3.0.7-28.el9_4) → explicit install" and "Origin: explicit install". The notes say: "classification relies only on the lock file. Being in the lock file means explicit install."

assertion_results.text: Remediation creates a single task for the Konflux release repo — not the two-task upstream backport + downstream propagation flow used for source dependency ecosystems (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation — system package path)
assertion_results.evidence: remediation.md Decision: "Ecosystem is RPM, a system package, so **1 task per stream** (a Konflux release repo fix)." A single 'Remediation Task (Case B, stream 2.2.x)' targets Repository rhtpa-release.0.4.z. The checklist states: "Task count per stream: 1, because RPM is a system package" and "no Blocks between upstream and downstream (single task)". The 2.1.x preemptive task is a separate cross-stream task, not an upstream/downstream pair.

assertion_results.text: Remediation task description follows task-description-template.md format with Repository, Target Branch, Description, Implementation Notes, and Acceptance Criteria sections — Files to Modify is intentionally omitted per remediation-templates.md (Step 8 Remediation Task Creation)
assertion_results.evidence: The remediation.md task description block contains the headings '## Repository' (rhtpa-release.0.4.z), '## Target Branch' (main), '## Description', '## Implementation Notes' and '## Acceptance Criteria', plus Test Requirements and Dependencies. There is no 'Files to Modify' section.

assertion_results.text: The version impact output addresses SBOM verification in the dependency chain context — either noting that verification was skipped because cosign is not available or because external tools are prohibited, or presenting the SBOM classification result (Step 2.3.5 Optional SBOM verification)
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md 2.3.5: "SBOM verification: ⚠️ skipped — cosign not available (cosign/`which cosign` not run in this eval and no external registry access permitted ...). Using rpms.lock.yaml classification only." The same note appears for the 2.1.x stream.
